blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. presented the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Prize 2026 to a Myanmar researcher for her work on disaster resilience, as the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits opened at the Philippine International Convention Center. Marcos was joined by Asean Secretary-General Dr. Kao Kim Hourn in awarding the trophy to Researcher and Disaster Resilience Advocate Hla Hla Aung for her “tireless work as a regional scientist in disaster resilience and preparedness in Myanmar.” The prize, first awarded in 2018, recognizes individuals or organizations whose outstanding contributions have advanced regional cooperation and cultivates the spirit […]...
